M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)). M6 sprint (2026-11-18; the live log of that day, 20:25:31 UTC: the learn step named Comfrey 767, Powdered Malachite 788, Dragonsblood 769, Hazel Talisman 746 and Powdered Turquoise 792 short, 'no vendor of Holtburg sells it', and at 20:29:54 the server refused Lifestone Recall for its components): Archmage Cindrue sells all five: SELECT id, weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 2304 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id IN (746, 767, 769, 788, 792), read-only on the world copy, 2026-11-18: rows 21033 Hazel Talisman (Value 5), 20980 Comfrey (Value 10), 20982 Dragonsblood (Value 10), 21003 Powdered Malachite (Value 5) and 21007 Powdered Turquoise (Value 5), PropertyInt 19; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 14 and 7. They are wares only, no stock line: the learn step's shopping list buys a component by the vendor's row, and the loader takes a spell component as a ware without a supply line (GroundCatalog.CheckSupplies); whether a trip keeps them in the pack for the recall is TODO(m6-recall-components-stock). The Gold Scarab 687 the same log names is no row of her list. Lifestone Recall (spell 1635) burns, on the full formula of the accounts test and qwinnie (the dats, HuntingGroundDatTests), the Copper Scarab, the Indigo and White Tapers, Comfrey, Turpeth, the Rowan Talisman and Powdered Malachite; the rows of her create list this profile still lacked are listed the same way (the same SELECT, 2026-11-18): Rowan Talisman 750 (row 21029, Value 5, 7).
sources.spell_plan: M6 3 p1, from the ladder rung 'cave' (ladder/war-mage.json, spell_level 3-4, element fire) and D41: character levels 22-26 cast Flame Bolt III; character levels 27-31 cast Flame Bolt IV. The crossing levels are SpellPlan.LevelAt (Mage/SpellPlan.cs) over SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase at plan_cast_chance 0.95, read for every level 10 to 44 (level 15 base 139 is II, 16 base 145 is III; 26 base 191 is III, 27 base 194 is IV; 41 base 240 is IV, 42 base 243 is V; the skill a level needs is its power + 43: II 93, III 143, IV 193, V 243); the rows stay in the rung's band and do not overlap. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40): the IV row runs to 39 with the rung's band; read again on the planner of M6 item 14 (SpellPlan.ProjectedWarBase): 26 base 188 is III, 27 base 193 is IV, 31 base 206 and 39 base 234 are IV (V needs 243) M6 14 (D135, the owner, 2026-11-13: the study's bands, the Cave 21-24): the III row starts at 21 with the rung's band (21 base 169 is III).
sources.components: the foci formula, as the Temple 40+'s (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts over the dats' Flame Bolt formulas; HuntingGroundDatTests.A_dungeons_components_cover_the_war_lines_formula_at_every_spell_level_its_plan_names pins the foci formula): Flame Bolt III (spell 82): 1 Copper Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper; Flame Bolt IV (spell 83): 1 Silver Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper. M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: III (spell level 3): Copper Scarab, Red Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; IV (spell level 4): Silver Scarab, Pink Taper, Hawthorn, Blue Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above.
sources.supplies: M6 3 p1, sized from the rung 'cave' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 224 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 5.6 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1254 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt IV as the worst case, 3 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 3762 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 650 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 210 (a third of the keep), stop_under 4 (a cast needs 3). Scarabs (Cindrue: Iron 689 at 68, Copper 686 at 135, Silver 688 at 338, the draft's town half, Value x 1.35): the cap level's keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2; a lower level's keep 10, trip_under 3; no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast (Flame Bolt II's 0.05, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d; III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), so 20 scarabs last 3.2 hours at 1254 casts an hour. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 30,110 pyreals at the vendors' prices; purse: coin 31,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (the Pathwarden robe and the Training Wand serve; a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health drinks): Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth Cort the Healer; BoostValue 25 on Health, Value 170, burden 15; 230 pyreals by the price rule): keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, listed before the Mana Potion so a short trip budget fills it first. Sized from the live hits of 2026-11-11 in the Tusker Cave (886 hits, mean 3.79, the largest plain hit 9, criticals of 13 and 18; 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack on her at health 114): a drink from the magic stance takes 2.5 s, so one Potion of Healing is 10 health a second, about what such a pack deals, and the 20 to 30 s a way out takes are 8 to 12 drinks; keep 30 is two to three of those and trip_under 6 is half of one (a trip the purse cannot pay is held back, LogisticsCounters.IsHeldBack). The fight drinks one only when the mana pays no heal or the next hit kills (HealthDrinks.Emergency), so the stock is a reserve and not a ration. Thelnoth sells no Health Tincture 27319 (50 health, 20 health a second): the nearest seller by the travel file is Ludora the Healer 2229 in Dryreach, a trip not built (TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip)); the Health Draught 2457 he also sells restores 10, 4 health a second, under what three tuskers deal, and is not stocked. The purse's coin is 73,000 (it was 70,000): the first fill of every sold line with the thirty Potions of Healing (6,900) stays inside the coin and the one note (HuntingGroundTests, the first-fill check). M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): the Mana Potion keeps 100 (it was 200): the Mana Tincture of the town stock (30, bought at the stop in Dryreach) is the main mana drink while held, and the potions are the fallback for a short purse, a failed stop and the top-ups of 25 to 49 missing; 100 of them are 2,500 mana, one stretch between trips at the Cave's 4,000 an hour, and the four drinks together weigh 4,050. The Health Tincture's stop is built (the town_stock section; TODO(m6-health-tincture-trip) closed).

town_stock.name: Health Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: carry health tinctures): Ludora the Healer 2229 of Dryreach, landblock_instance guid 0x7DA75026 at (177.166, 78.3451, 18.005) in landblock 0xDA75, outdoors (the row stores cell 0; the cell is the point's, x/24*8 + y/24 + 1 = 0x3C); her create list (destination 4) holds the Health Tincture 27319 (BoostValue 50 on Health, Value 500, burden 50) and her SellPrice is 1.55: 775 pyreals (max(1, ceil(1.55 x 500 - 0.1))); SELECTs on the world copy. Thelnoth of Holtburg does not sell it. The stop is made on the way out, from the Town Network (network-to-dryreach drops 48.8 m from her, dryreach-to-network stands 59.9 m from her: travel-routes.json). keep 12, trip_under 6: with a pack on her (8 to 11.6 health a second, 2026-11-11) a tincture a drink of 2.5 s is 20 health a second, the one drink that out-heals it; a stand of 20 to 30 s takes about 6, so the keep is two stands and the trip line one. The walk from the drop to her is not walked live yet (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 T (the owner, 2026-11-11: Mana Tinctures too): Ludora's create list (destination 4) holds the Mana Tincture 27322 (BoostValue 50 on Mana, Value 500, burden 50): 775 pyreals at her SellPrice 1.55; a SELECT on the world copy. It is the main mana drink while held (ManaDrinks: the biggest drink that fits whole in the missing mana). keep 30, trip_under 10: the Tusker Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11 between trips about 35 minutes apart, 2,333 mana a stretch; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, so the two cover a stretch and two thirds of the next, and the potions alone still cover one when the stop fails or the purse holds it back. The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks.

town_stock.name: Gold Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab; live 2026-11-12: at level 38, War Magic 297, with Flame Bolt V and Heal Self V in the book she cast level IV of everything, each skip named 'needs Gold Scarab 687, which the pack does not hold'): level V burns a Gold Scarab on the foci formula (GearKit.FociFormulaCounts) and no vendor of Holtburg sells one. The seller: Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz 1824 of Uziz, landblock_instance guid 0x7A260006 at (182.987, 40.1413, 17.205) in the room 0xA2600112; his create list (destination_Type 4) holds the Gold Scarab 687 (row 68790) and the Pyreal Scarab 690 (row 68791), the Gold Scarab's Value is 500, its burden 4 and its stack 100 (weenie_properties_int types 19, 5, 11), and his SellPrice (weenie_properties_float type 38) is 1.55: 775 pyreals, max(1, ceil(1.55 x 500 - 0.1)) (Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d). Read-only SELECTs on the world copy, 2026-11-12: the sellers are SELECT object_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 687, each with its landblock_instance row and its float 38; the towns the Town Network reaches are the weenie_properties_position rows (position_Type 2) of the portals placed in landblock 0x0007, none with a MinLevel or MaxLevel row (ints 86, 87) but the Facility Hub's, the Refuge's and Eastwatch's. Why Uziz: the sellers that stand in a landblock a Network portal drops in, by the straight line from the drop: Neydisa's Philomon 40.5 m (no path on the dats from the drop to him or to the portal back: TODO(m6-neydisa-walk), TODO(m6-neydisa-network-front)), Fiun's Archmage 46.3 m, Uziz's Sammam 47.8 m, Xarabydun's Janier al-Evv 72.0 m and Timaru's Elder Shaman 78.9 m (neither walk planned whole on the dats when tried on 2026-11-12; not pinned by a test), Linvak Tukal's Imbuer 72.0 m and 79 m higher, Najmima the Archmage 185 m from the Khayyaban drop, Lin's Ta Ban-Yu 223 m, Sawato's Tawa Matema 239 m, Fort Tethana's Zisaha 377 m with the portal back behind the lever gate (the last five are no candidates: each is farther in a straight line than Uziz's walk to his counter, or 79 m above its drop). Fiun and Uziz are the two whose walks plan whole and are confirmed by the walker's physics (TownNetworkWalkDatTests, the town stock cases: Uziz's legs are judged, Fiun's logged beside them): by Uziz the drop to his counter is 76.8 m and his counter to the portal back 69.9 m; by Fiun 63.4 m and 60.8 m. With the Network's own legs from Holtburg's drop 0x00070143 and on to the Facility Hub portal (77.2 m and 52.2 m by Uziz, 134.7 m and 37.4 m by Fiun; 69.6 m with no stop) the whole stop is 276 m by Uziz and 296 m by Fiun, and Fiun's SellPrice is 1.8 (900 pyreals): Uziz is the shorter and the cheaper. Neither of Uziz's portals has a gate or a quest flag (travel-routes.json: network-to-uziz, uziz-to-network), and nothing in its landblock attacks: the creatures placed in 0xA260 are the Archmage, the Ivory Crafter, the Collector and the Agent of the Arcanum (PlayerKillerStatus 16, not attackable), and its one encounter row is the Harmless Gharun Generator 5151 at cell (1, 1) (Desert Rabbit and Chicken, level 4), over 80 m from the walk. His room is indoors: the way in and out passes the door 0x7A260000 (weenie 1148 in 0xA2600100; closed, not locked, as Holtburg's doors), which the runner Uses; the planner and the physics confirm the walk through its doorway both ways, the door itself is unproven live (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)). Sizing: a cast burns each slot of its formula with the chance ComponentLoss x CDM x min(1, Power / skill) (Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d); the dats give ComponentLoss 0.2 for Flame Bolt V, Heal Self V, Harm Other V, Fire Vulnerability Other V and Imperil Other V and 0.5 for Drain Health Other V, and CDM 0.1 for a scarab (ComponentWeenies; the Prismatic Taper's is 1): 0.02 Gold Scarabs a bolt at the factor 1 (0.0135 at War Magic 297, power 200), 25.1 an hour at the rung's modelled 1,254 casts (sources.supplies). keep 100 is one stack (burden 400, 77,500 pyreals) and 4 hours of that; trip_under 40: the stop is made only once 60 are burned, at most every 2 h 23 min at the worst case, and the 40 left are 96 minutes of it, more than the hour between two trips out. It is bought only while a spell of the book burns it (TownStock.UnusedWhy), it has no stop line, and with none held every pick falls to the level the pack pays for (LevelFloor), as before this line.
